subject: Error in lavaanify: wrong number of arguments in modifier

messages.author: 2f41c1764121050d
messages.subject: Error in lavaanify: wrong number of arguments in modifier
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to obtain the model syntax in tabular form using lavaanify(), but am receiving an error that there are a wrong number of arguments in the modifer.

Here's a small reproducible example in the context of adapting example of testing measurement invariance from the lavaan tutorial (http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/groups.html):

#Specify model
cfaModel <- '
 visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
 textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
 speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9
'

#Measurement Invariance Syntax
configuralInvarianceModel <- measEq.syntax(configural.model = cfaModel,
                                           data = HolzingerSwineford1939,
                                           ID.fac = "std.lv",
                                           group = "school")


configuralInvarianceSyntax <- as.character(configuralInvarianceModel)

#Summary of Model Features
summary(configuralInvarianceModel)

#Print Lavaan Syntax
cat(as.character(configuralInvarianceModel))

#Model Syntax in tabular form
lavaanify(cfaModel) #no error
lavaanify(configuralInvarianceSyntax) #ERROR
lavaanify(configuralInvarianceModel) #ERROR

Here's the error I receive:

Error in lavaanify(configuralInvarianceModel) :
  lavaan ERROR: wrong number of arguments in modifier (lambda.1_1.g1,lambda.1_1.g2) of element visual=~x1

There are two groups in the HolzingerSwineford1939 data set, and two labels for the factor loadings in the syntax, so I'm unsure why I'm getting this error.  Here's the model syntax:

> cat(as.character(configuralInvarianceModel))
